source.title: Kailera: KaiNETIC global Phase 3 enrolment completed
source.evidenceType: Original sponsor programme announcement; not regulatory approval

fields.stage: Global Phase 3 KaiNETIC programme fully enrolled
fields.summary: Kailera's 30 September 2026 announcement says enrolment is complete across the three global Phase 3 KaiNETIC injection trials: approximately 2,500 adults in KaiNETIC-1, 1,200 in KaiNETIC-2 and 1,200 in KaiNETIC-3. Topline data are expected in mid-2028; this is a planned date, not a completed result.
fields.limitations: This sponsor-reported enrolment milestone is not a trial result, regulatory approval or evidence of UK access or supply. The three injection trials have different populations and comparators. It does not advance the separate oral ribupatide programme.

ukPosition.marketingAuthorisation: The reviewed source does not establish UK marketing authorisation for ribupatide.
ukPosition.nhsEnglandAccess: The reviewed source does not establish a NICE recommendation or NHS England access.
ukPosition.supply: Trial enrolment does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.

uncertainty: Topline data are expected in mid-2028; the timing is forward-looking and may change.
The announcement reports programme-level enrolment and does not provide trial results.
